search_text: published ZDI-25-983 ZDI-CAN-27913 evernote-mcp-server openBrowser Command Injection Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2025-10-30 CVE-2025-12489 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-12489 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['evernote-mcp-server'] ['evernote-mcp-server'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of evernote-mcp-server. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the openBrowser function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. title: evernote-mcp-server openBrowser Command Injection Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of evernote-mcp-server. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the openBrowser function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account.
